purpose: Create immutable, traceable versions of published property answers, preserving the evidence, legal versions, source states, review result and predecessor relationship that supported each publication.
snapshot_rules: A changed answer creates a new snapshot rather than silently overwriting the old one.
A new snapshot retains a predecessor link where it revises an earlier answer.
Historical snapshots remain associated with their original target date and source/legal versions.
Current answer snapshots can be flagged for reverification without altering their historical publication record.
A snapshot must preserve enough source/version metadata to reconstruct why the answer was published.
withdrawal_rules: Withdrawal requires a recorded reason and verification event.
Withdrawal does not erase the historical existence of the published snapshot.
A corrected answer must receive a new snapshot identity.
hard_stops: Never overwrite a published answer in place.
Never change the source/legal version attached to a published snapshot without creating a new snapshot.
Never mark a historical snapshot current merely because it remains visible.
Never publish without a passed quality gate.
Never claim a snapshot is verified if its required provenance is incomplete.
